rationale: Christine is building healthcare data infrastructure at Lattice Health, while Jug is a med student actively shipping healthcare-adjacent products like SwipeBite and a meeting transcriber. Jug's hands-on experience building and shipping products, combined with healthcare domain knowledge, could offer practical insights into real-world healthcare workflows that inform data interoperability challenges.
intro_message: Christine Park, meet Jug — you're both operating at the intersection of healthcare and product building, and Jug's shipped several healthcare tools that might offer useful perspective on the interoperability challenges you're solving at Lattice Health.
